## Research projects

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
S-LAB, Jeonbuk National University
:::

[Transferability and Configuration Sensitivity of Clinical Prediction Models across Imaging, Time-Series, and Tabular Data](project-transferability.qmd){.research-title}

Whether a transfer-learning gain survives the training configuration — seeds,
splits, prevalence, thresholds, noise. Three tasks stand in for three kinds of
transfer: breast imaging, continuous glucose time series, and tabular COVID-19
outcomes.

::: {.research-links}
[Project page](project-transferability.qmd){.research-btn}
:::

:::

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
S-LAB, Jeonbuk National University
:::

[Chest CT-Based Prediction of Pulmonary Function and Evaluation of Model Explainability](project-airway-ct.qmd){.research-title}

Predicts airflow limitation from hundreds of correlated quantitative CT measures
taken during lung cancer screening. It then asks whether competing explanations
agree on *why*, not just on *what*.

::: {.research-links}
[Project page](project-airway-ct.qmd){.research-btn}
:::

:::

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
Department of Statistics, Jeonbuk National University
:::

[A Bootstrap Algorithm for Comparing Diagnostic Test Accuracy in Meta-Analysis with Within-Study Correlation](project-dauc-bootstrap.qmd){.research-title}

Comparing two diagnostic tests across published studies usually treats them as
independent, even when the same participants took both. A correlation-aware
bootstrap carries that dependence through, and simulations report what it
buys.

::: {.research-links}
[Project page](project-dauc-bootstrap.qmd){.research-btn}
:::

:::

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
University of Nevada, Las Vegas
:::

[Deep Neural Networks for Mortality Prediction from EHR Vital-Sign Time Series](project-ehr-mortality.qmd){.research-title}

Mortality prediction from irregularly sampled vital signs at a Brazilian cancer
center, crossing two interpolation schemes with two network architectures. The
convolutional models won on every metric.

::: {.research-links}
[Project page](project-ehr-mortality.qmd){.research-btn}
:::

:::

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
Department of Statistics, Jeonbuk National University
:::

[Deep Learning-based Neural Granger Causality for Solar Radiation Time Series](project-granger.qmd){.research-title}

Whether neural Granger causality recovers predictive relationships among
meteorological variables that a linear vector autoregression misses. Covers the
assumptions behind both before the applied analysis of solar radiation
records.

::: {.research-links}
[Project page](project-granger.qmd){.research-btn}
:::

:::

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
Independent research project
:::

[Effectiveness of Digital Cognitive Training Interventions for Dementia: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis](project-dementia-meta.qmd){.research-title}

A PROSPERO-registered systematic review and meta-analysis of remotely delivered
cognitive training in dementia. Covers the literature screening, the data
extraction and the pooled analysis of cognitive and depressive outcomes.

::: {.research-links}
[Project page](project-dementia-meta.qmd){.research-btn}
:::

:::

## Conference presentations

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
Korean Data and Information Science Society 2026
:::

[Assessing the Reliability of Clinical AI: Reproducibility of Transfer Learning across Three Medical Modalities](files/poster-reproducibility-2026.pdf){.research-title target="_blank"}

::: {.research-authors}
*N. Y. Kim*, H. Choi, H. Kim, G. Kim, S. Hwang · November 2026, Busan
:::

One factor isolated per task — source pretraining, amount of adaptation, whether
a large source stage exists at all — then carried to another institution,
country or cohort. The direction of the gain held across all three domains; its
size did not.

::: {.research-links}
[Poster PDF](files/poster-reproducibility-2026.pdf){.research-btn target="_blank"}
:::

:::

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
Korean Data and Information Science Society 2026
:::

[Explainable AI under Correlated Features: Do Models Agree on Why? An Application to Airflow Limitation Detection from Quantitative Chest CT](files/poster-airway-ct-2026.pdf){.research-title target="_blank"}

::: {.research-authors}
H. Kim, *N. Y. Kim*, Y. Lee, K. Chae, S. Hwang · November 2026, Busan
:::

Three models detect airflow limitation at nearly the same accuracy, then are
asked what they used. Once the correlated measures were reduced they stopped
agreeing, while AUROC barely moved.

::: {.research-links}
[Poster PDF](files/poster-airway-ct-2026.pdf){.research-btn target="_blank"}
:::

:::

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
IC-KDA + ASAD 2025 · Best Poster Award
:::

[Effectiveness of Digital Cognitive Training Interventions for Dementia: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis](files/poster-dementia-2025.pdf){.research-title target="_blank"}

::: {.research-authors}
J. Sung, *N. Y. Kim* · May 2025, Seoul
:::

Eleven randomized trials pooled for cognitive and depressive outcomes. Remotely
delivered cognitive training improved both, on a small evidence base.

::: {.research-links}
[Poster PDF](files/poster-dementia-2025.pdf){.research-btn target="_blank"}
[PROSPERO](https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/prospero/display_record.php?RecordID=631806){.research-btn}
:::

:::

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
Korean Statistical Society Summer Conference 2025
:::

[Deep Learning-based Neural Granger Causality for Solar Radiation Time Series](files/poster-granger-2025.pdf){.research-title target="_blank"}

::: {.research-authors}
M. Lee, S. Lee, Y. Cho, *N. Y. Kim*, G. Kim, Y. Lee · June 2025, Gyeongju
:::

Neural Granger causality recovers meteorological drivers of solar radiation that
a linear vector autoregression misses. It does so for the variables that behave
least like continuous measurements.

::: {.research-links}
[Poster PDF](files/poster-granger-2025.pdf){.research-btn target="_blank"}
